title: Aluminium product makers seek zero import duty on raw metal ahead of Budget
description:
Ahead of the Union budget for 2027-28, aluminium product manufacturers have urged the government to allow duty-free imports of raw metal to boost domestic consumption and enhance the competitiveness of small enterprises.
Manufacturers' body ALEMAI has written a letter to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, seeking to bring down the basic customs duty on primary aluminium to zero, arguing that the current 7.5 per cent levy, which translates into an effective import duty of 8.25 per cent including social welfare surcharge, is hurting MSMEs (micro, small and medium enterprises) and domestic value addition.
"We respectfully request the government in the forthcoming Union Budget...the basic customs duty on primary aluminium under tariff heading 7601 (be reduced) from 7.5 per cent to 0 per cent," Aluminium Extrusion Manufacturers Association of India (ALEMAI) said in the letter.
